name: SEO Factory
description: Continuous SEO for any website or SaaS: describe the site once, connect Search Console, Google Trends and a mailbox or Slack, audit it, then let a scheduled agent improve it every few days — pull requests when the site lives in a Git repository, ready-to-paste recommendations in Google Slides when it runs on a CMS. Every action is tracked on a GitHub board or a shared Google Sheet, owners get a weekly email of what waits for them, and labeling an issue claude:fix gets it fixed in a pull request.
